fit_standard_scaler: fit a StandardScaler on a dataset to learn means and standard deviations across features
transform_with_scaler: transform crystal property data by subtracting means and dividing by standard deviations using StandardScaler
inverse_transform_scaler: inverse transform normalized crystal data back to original scale using StandardScaler inverse_transform
create_scaler_with_precomputed_stats: create a StandardScaler initialized with precomputed CompScalerMeans and CompScalerStds for crystal properties
lookup_chemical_symbol: look up a chemical element symbol by index from the chemical_symbols list
